notes: Benin, 2005 survey of 306 households plus focus groups on yam-based systems with Mucuna pruriens and Aeschynomene histrix intercropped with maize, biomass incorporated before yam (green manure / cover crop, fits cover_crops; not CA; crop_livestock_integration is out_of_scope). The only quantified results are the frequency and 'constraint degree of severity' of perceived constraints (Table 2 and Table 3, page 6). It reports no adoption rate, no adoption determinants model, no cost or return values (fertilizer cost appears only as a named constraint), and no carbon values. Judgement call: perceived-constraint rankings were not treated as adoption drivers. If the team decides constraint severity counts as an adoption driver ('other' measure), this paper would be included with about 17 household-level and 9 focus-group constraint rows.
